Between the request read and the open there is NO '..' rejection, NO basename extraction, NO startswith/base-dir containment check, NO realpath/normpath canonicalization - none exists anywhere in app/ (verified by grep over the whole tree). os.path.join semantics: a 'name' like '../../etc/passwd' or an absolute path (or a drive letter on Windows, where CONFIG_PATH defaults under app/static/config) escapes CONFIG_PATH entirely - CWE-22/73; the write side additionally enables arbitrary-file-write/overwrite (with pickle content, pass-6 adjacent).

TOCTOU: routes.py:430-431 evaluates open(config_pkl,'rb') only when os.path.exists(config_pkl) - an existence check (not containment) forming a classic check-then-use pattern; the session loop also does getsize (routes.py:100) before open (:103).

Percent-decoding boundary: request.args values are already percent-decoded by werkzeug before the handler (framework-level decode; no explicit unquote is needed for the /config chain, so no decode node sits between source and sink); explicit decodes exist elsewhere (urlparse.unquote/unquote_plus at routes.py:285-286/:348/:383/:410, request.py:163, filter.py:634-643) and are emitted as url_decode rows.
Mixed separators / absolute paths: no separator normalization ('\\', '/') is applied to the 'name' value anywhere; no is_absolute()/drive checks exist in this app at all.

Base directories: CONFIG_PATH (env CONFIG_VOLUME, default app/static/config), SESSION_FILE_DIR (CONFIG_PATH/session), BANG_PATH, BUILD_FOLDER, STATIC_FOLDER - all resolved at app init from env or __file__ (__init__.py:43-99) - operator inputs, not request inputs (the only request input joined onto a base is request.args.get('name')).

Session-file maintenance channel (semi-trusted): session_required walks os.listdir(SESSION_FILE_DIR) (routes.py:93), joins each listed name (:94-96), getsize-guards (:100), opens and pickle.loads (:103-105) and os.remove's invalid sessions (:117) - filenames come from the directory listing, not directly from a request; the broad except at :109-113 exists precisely because unrelated files can appear in that directory (documented in-code), making this loop a directory-content-driven file-access family.

Symlinks: os.symlink used only for cache-busting build links (app/__init__.py:157-163) over os.listdir-derived internal names; no symlink-following or link-creation on request-controlled paths exists.

Framework static file serving: Flask(__name__, static_folder=app/static) (app/__init__.py:23-24) registers the implicit /static/<path:filename> route served by werkzeug's safe-join machinery OUTSIDE project source - not extractable from this database (see uncoveredCases).

Session trust: the flask session cookie is signed with the instance SECRET_KEY (app/__init__.py:102-110); session['config'] values originate from default_config or POST /config request.form data (routes.py:437-449) - a signed but attacker-influenced store, reloaded as Config(**session['config']) (routes.py:155) whose values then flow into URL/HTML construction, not into file paths.

No sanitizer evidence for pass 1: no startswith(base-dir) guard, no canonicalize-and-compare, no basename-only mode anywhere in the codebase (the only path validation is os.path.exists/isfile/getsize existence probing).
